fields.name: Name
fields.category_placeholder: Pick or type a new one
fields.notes_placeholder: Your notes: where it was used, substitutes…

components.search_placeholder: Search: name, MPN, package, location, description…
components.empty: No components match the selected filters.

bulk.move_hint: All stock of the selected components moves to this location
bulk.delete_confirm: Move {n} components to the trash? They can be restored from Trash.

stock.per_location: Stored in several locations – click for stock per location

drawer.delete_confirm: Move "{name}" to the trash? It can be restored from Trash.
drawer.no_params: No parameters. Add the ones that matter to you by hand (e.g. from the datasheet).
drawer.unsaved_message: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
drawer.copy_hint: New component with the same data (without MPN and stock), e.g. another value of the same series
drawer.copied: Copy of "{name}" – change what you need and click Add

files.zoom_hint: Click the image to view it full screen

lookup.title: Find component online
lookup.find_online_hint: Fill in data from the Element14 / Mouser catalogs
lookup.placeholder: MPN or keywords (e.g. IRFZ44N, NE555 SOIC)
lookup.summary: {n} unique parts · click a row to use its data
lookup.no_services: Lookup needs a free Mouser or Element14 API key. See Settings for how to get one. You can also add components by hand.
lookup.variants: {n} variants – they differ in package / packaging
lookup.package_inferred: Derived from the other variants of the same family
lookup.step2_hint: Checked fields will be written to the form. Fields that already have a value are unchecked by default.

locations.intro: Locations can be nested (Cabinet › Drawer › Box). Click a name to list its components – the QR label does the same from a phone.
locations.delete_confirm: Move location "{name}" to the trash? Sublocations and stock move to: {target}. Restoring it from Trash moves everything back.
locations.print_hint: The QR code opens the component list for that location. The phone must be on the same network as this computer.
locations.qr_address: App address in the QR code
locations.localhost_warning: "localhost" only works on this computer – pick a local network address for phones.

categories.edit_hint: Click a category name to rename it, press Enter to confirm.

settings.api_intro: Enabled services are queried at the same time by "Find online". Keys are stored only in the local database.
settings.test_ok: Works – a test search returned {n} results.
settings.clear_cache_hint: Search results are cached for 24h to save API quota
settings.local_files_intro: Images are saved locally when a component is saved, so they work offline. Datasheets can be saved with the button next to the link.
settings.backup_intro: Database size: {size}. A backup is a complete copy of the database made while the app is running.
settings.restore_hint: Restore: stop the app and replace inventory.db in the data folder (see "About") with the chosen backup file.
settings.lan: On your local network (e.g. from a phone): {urls}
settings.primary_source_hint: When the same part exists at several services, data is taken from this one; the others only fill in what is missing. In the lookup you can still pick another source per field.
settings.key_where: Online lookup needs an API key from Mouser or Element14. You get one by registering for free on their website:

import.title: Import components
import.intro: Choose a CSV file – from Excel: File → Save As → CSV. Columns are detected automatically, and you see what will be added before importing. A file made with Export in this app works too.
import.too_short: The file needs a header and at least one row.
import.need_name: Choose the column for Name or MPN – import is not possible without one.
import.existing: Components that already exist (same MPN, or same name when there is no MPN):

trash.intro: Everything that was deleted – components, locations and categories – waits here and can be restored until you empty the trash.
trash.purge_confirm: "{name}" will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
trash.empty_confirm: Permanently delete all {n} items in the trash? This cannot be undone.
trash.skipped: Not restored: {n} (a component with the same MPN exists)
trash.mpn_exists_title: A component with the same MPN already exists
trash.mpn_exists: "{name}" ({mpn}) was added in the meantime. Restore this one too, so both exist?
trash.note_location: Its location was deleted, so the pieces were restored without a location.
trash.note_category: Its category was deleted, so it was restored without a category.
trash.note_merged: A category with the same name already exists – components were restored into it.
trash.note_renamed: A location with the same name already exists there, so it was restored with a number in its name.
